column3: MOVIE POSTER KEY ART: a small Vietnamese clay alley at dawn, pastel shophouses, soft mist. Hun stands in the centre of the alley hugging against its belly a small clay model of a cosy house with sage-green shutters; low sun behind Hun makes a glowing rim light. Behind Hun, the front door of a home is ajar and a hand in a sage-green cardigan sleeve waves from the doorway. Keep the lower third of the frame calm and darker (empty ground) for the title. No text.

MOVIE POSTER KEY ART, portrait: a small Vietnamese clay alley at dawn, pastel shophouses, soft mist. Hun stands in the centre hugging against its belly a small clay model of a cosy house with sage-green shutters; low sun behind Hun makes a glowing rim light. Behind Hun, a door ajar with a hand in a sage-green cardigan sleeve waving. Keep the lower 35% calm and darker for the title. No text.

06:30, soft cool pink dawn light. A clay kitchen. The kettle on the stove starts to steam. Hun stands on a small wooden-clay stool next to the wall and flips the "4 little tasks" board (as in props-sheet, all slots empty) with its beak. The empty fish jar sits on a shelf behind. Medium shot.

06:30, soft dawn light. A breakfast table. A hand in a sage-green cardigan sleeve with a jade bangle holds a cream coffee cup, not drinking, resting on the table. Hun, standing on the table, pushes with its whole body a small wooden tray toward the hand; on the tray seven round clay mood stones in a row from sad (blue, frown) to happy (pink, smile). Hun's flippers stay short against the tray. Medium close-up.

06:30, warm dawn light. Close-up on the breakfast table: an index finger of a hand in a sage-green cardigan sleeve touches the fifth mood stone (peach, small smile), which glows softly; the coffee cup is lifted slightly. Hun, beside the tray, holds both short flippers against its cheeks with a quiet happy smile. Close-up.

12:00, bright white noon light with striped shadows from shutters. A clay kitchen shelf with a round clay wall clock (no numbers, hands pointing straight up). A small clay smartphone on the shelf vibrates, its screen shows only a bell icon and a pill icon. Hun stands below looking up, surprised, its head tuft standing up. Medium shot.

12:00, bright noon light. A living-room table: two hands in a navy-and-white striped shirt sleeve with a brown leather wristwatch hold a folded clay newspaper. Hun pushes with its whole body a colourful seven-compartment clay pill organiser right up to the hand; one compartment lid is open. Medium close-up.

12:00, bright noon light. On the table: a clay blood pressure monitor whose screen shows only a small green heart icon; next to it a clay phone on a little stand, its screen shows a picture of a small countryside clay house and a heart icon. Hun hugs a second small clay phone against its belly, nodding. On the wall behind, the "4 little tasks" board with the heart slot crossed out. Medium shot.

17:45, warm golden-orange late afternoon light from the door. A kitchen table: a hand in a sage-green cardigan sleeve sets down a woven clay market basket full of clay vegetables and a bánh mì. On the table a clay phone lights up with a single speech-bubble shape (no text). Hun looks up from the table edge. Medium shot.

17:45, warm golden light. Hun sits on the table in front of a clay phone; a soft speech-bubble shape floats out of the phone and turns into a neat line in an open clay notebook, next to a small golden coin. Hun watches, curious. Medium close-up.

17:45, warm sunset rim light. Hun stands right next to a round terracotta clay savings jar with a lotus relief, hugging a big golden clay coin against its belly, about to drop it into the slot. On the wall behind, a piece of yarn pinned between two clay pins marks a budget line, stopping at the middle mark. Medium close-up.

Sunday 19:00, warm yellow lamp light, cosy. A low round clay family table with four different clay tea cups. Hands around the table: a sage cardigan sleeve with jade bangle, a navy striped sleeve with wristwatch, a small mustard-yellow sleeve. Hun pours tea from a small clay teapot hugged against its body; a little tea spills onto a saucer. Medium-wide shot.

Sunday 19:00, warm lamp light. In the middle of the table a small bar chart of seven stacked pastel clay block columns, the last column lower than the others. A small hand in a mustard-yellow sleeve points at the low column; a hand in a navy striped sleeve gives a thumbs-up. Hun does a tiny happy hop on the table. Medium shot.

Sunday 19:00, warm light. A wall with a clay Vietnamese tear-off lunar calendar (no numbers, one day circled in red clay). Below, at the front door, a row of clay slippers of the family plus one new unfamiliar pair. The "4 little tasks" board on the wall has heart, pill and coin slots crossed out and the house slot being crossed out by Hun standing on a stool. Medium shot.

22:30, dark blue night, the house asleep, only a small warm bedside lamp. Hun sits on a cushion writing in a tiny clay diary resting on its lap with a stubby clay pencil held against its belly. Medium shot.

22:30, night, lamp light. Hun places the tiny diary into a small clay box with a heart-shaped padlock, then (same frame) the window curtain is half drawn by Hun pulling a cord with its beak. Medium shot.

22:30, deep blue night with moonlight through the window. Hun curled up asleep under a tiny patchwork clay blanket next to the fish jar, now full of tiny orange clay fish; on the wall the "4 little tasks" board with all four slots crossed out; the bedside lamp is dimming. Medium-wide shot.
